scope: Authorized continuous full-pool main trajectory; 4000, 8000, 16000 and 32000 cumulative updates; no recipe changes or external weights.
question: How well can the complete conditional-geometry model learn and transfer after substantially broader exposure and optimization?

evaluation.primary: complete official public val19, including per-sequence curves and counts at the pooled thresholds; remains development data
evaluation.synthetic: all 120 validation worlds and all valid frozen target points; zero-anomaly and few-return frames retained; official filter secondary
evaluation.fixed_scopes: historical curves and error explanation only; never micro-stage pass requirements

sampling: unchanged positive probabilities over all 107760 training world-frames; two independent draws per update with replacement; 64000 requests are not an exhaustive epoch
continuation: same model, optimizer, preprocessing, RNG and global update stream; keep-weight schedule runs once; no automatic restart or learning-rate reset
decision: continue through the cumulative nodes without recipe selection; assess sustained joint AP/FPR95 deterioration using complete-val19 magnitude and sequence results, not one fluctuation or a small witness group
stop: 32000 updates, a numerical/resource failure, or an explicit user stop; persistent development degradation requires substantive review; no automatic parameter retry or budget extension
